creator.title: SCUTOONS Creator
creator.new_chapter_created: Chapter {number} is created as a draft and added to the season. Save to keep it.
creator.publish_confirm: Publish {file} ({locales})? Readers see it right away.
creator.publish_errors: {count} errors in the problem list. Publish anyway?
creator.note_message: A short note helps others see what changed in this draft.
creator.note_placeholder: Fixed the bubble positions in group 3
creator.publish_confirm_neutral: Publish {file}? Readers see it right away.
creator.nothing_to_save: Nothing to save: no changes since the last save.
creator.nothing_to_publish: Nothing to publish: everything here is already published.
creator.submit_confirm: {file} ({locales}) goes to the reviewers of this toon. They get a mail and publish it or send it back.
creator.submit_confirm_neutral: {file} goes to the reviewers of this toon. They get a mail and publish it or send it back.
creator.submit_note_placeholder: What changed, what to look at
creator.submitted: Submitted for review – {reviewers} got a mail.
creator.publish_tree_message: Every file below with a draft that readers don't see yet. Untick what should wait.
creator.review_newer: Newer drafts exist – not part of this review.
creator.review_publish_message: {file} goes live as submitted. {author} gets a mail.
creator.review_return_message: {author} gets your note by mail. The drafts stay as they are.
creator.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
creator.unpublish_confirm: Unpublish {file} ({locale})? Readers see nothing until a version is published again.
creator.change_type_confirm: Change event {index} to {type}? Its parameters are replaced.
creator.conflict: Someone saved a newer version of {file}. Reload to get it, or overwrite it with yours.
creator.import_slices_hint: Choose images: before anything is uploaded you see each one with the slice it replaces or "New slice", and can change it. Suggested: the slice whose image has the file's name (s1c1-slice-26, slice-26 or 26), else a new slice. New slices go after / before the selected slice or at the end. A replaced slice keeps its texts, items, events and audio (the old image stays as an earlier version). WebP in every size up to the delivered one: a 3x file (….3x.jpg or 1170 px wide) also gives 2x and 1x. Or drop an image onto a slice to replace its image.
creator.import_slices_height_message: The new image is {height} px high, the current one {old} px. Text boxes and items on this slice stay where they are and may no longer fit.
creator.import_slices_twice: Slice {number} is chosen twice – pick another target for one of them.
creator.tool_text: Text box – drag on the slice to draw one
creator.tool_item: Item – click on the slice to place one
creator.tool_sample: Sample area – drag on the slice to draw one
creator.vn_point_hint: A named point in this VN script: a divert, a choice or a slice event continues here.
creator.vn_no_points: This VN script has no points yet – add one (type “label”).
creator.vn_random_hint: A random group of these, never the one the reader is on (e.g. the stroll).
creator.repeat_outside_catalog: The catalog allows this item only {min} … {max} ({unit}) – {stored} stays stored. Shorter or longer: Catalog → the item → Respawn.
creator.tool_event: Event – drag an area on the slice for a tap event, click for one on the whole slice
creator.expr_canvas_preview: Texts with expressions: as written or as a sample reader sees them
creator.expr_empty_braces: empty braces – to show a brace, put a backslash before it
creator.expr_unsupported_list: `{a}` isn’t a list kind – use & (cycle), ~ (shuffle), ! (once only), ~! or ~$
creator.expr_conditional_too_many: a conditional text has one `|` at most: condition: then|else
creator.expr_stray_close: unmatched `}` – to show it, put a backslash before it
creator.expr_too_many_constructs: too many expressions in one text (more than {a})
creator.expr_text_too_long: text too long for expressions (more than {a} characters)
creator.expr_namespace_needs_member: `{a}` needs a name after it, e.g. `{b}`
creator.expr_or_in_list: `||` here splits a list (as in ink) – for “or”, write `or`
creator.expr_not_in_list: `!` at the start makes a once-only list (as in ink) – for “not”, write `not`
creator.expr_compare_text: `{a}` can’t compare texts – only `==` and `!=` can
creator.event_whole_slice_hint: No area: the trigger is the whole slice (click / hover anywhere, intersect when it scrolls into view). Off: an area to drag on the slice.
creator.preset_story_sample: It was the night before the Feast of the Cat.
creator.preset_lyrics_sample: I want to be a cloud, loud, loud, loud.
creator.tail_base_handle: Tail base – drag along the bubble’s edge
creator.tail_tip_handle: Tail tip – drag anywhere, also past the slice
creator.tail_tip_off: Tail tip – past the slice’s edge (drag it back in)
creator.legacy_texts: {count} text boxes still have the old look (a mask over text in the art). Converting gives each its preset – scene headings → Scene, captions → Speech, narration → Narration, bare texts → Story – and removes the masks. Save as a draft; publish once the text-free art is in.
creator.canvas_grid_size: Grid (px of the slice at 1x; 15 = the base grid, 30 = default)
creator.event_unknown: “{type}” is not played by the reader – choose a type above or remove the event.
creator.event_off_stage: {who} isn't in the scene here – the reader skips this message.
creator.event_off_stage_ask: {who} isn't in the scene here – the question shows without their face.
creator.canvas_snap_hint: Snap to the grid: moving, resizing and scaling in grid steps, rotating in 15° steps (Shift switches). Remembered on this device.
creator.canvas_snap_size: Snap {size} px – click: on / off; hold, right-click or the number: the grid size
creator.canvas_zoom: Zoom {percent} % – Ctrl + wheel over the slice
creator.text_revert: Undo the change (the old words back)
creator.layers_area_stays: A click / hover area stays on its slice – move it on the canvas or in its tab
creator.respawn_item_never: This item never reappears (catalog) – a one-time find. The catalog sets which items can reappear.
creator.respawn_item_range: The item allows {min} … {max}. Taken once per period; its max count still applies.
creator.reveal_box_hint: This text box stays hidden until this event, then appears with its effect. Its look (preset, font, colour, outline, rotation, scale, text) is set on the text box.
creator.slice_item_hint_pickup: The reader takes it into the inventory (a story grant: the item's rules apply – grantable, max count, once per place) and it is gone from the slice for them.
creator.slice_item_hint_events: The events run on a tap, like a click trigger whose area is the item.
creator.slice_item_not_grantable: This item can't be picked up from the story (catalog: grantable).
creator.status_hint: Visibility in the reader, per language: published = listed and readable, draft = hidden, coming soon = listed but not readable. Kept in the season ({file}), saved with the chapter.
creator.status_not_in_season: not in the season (invalid – every chapter belongs to a season)
creator.status_sync: This chapter still stores a status of its own – the status lives in the season now.
creator.season_missing: This toon has no season yet. Create season 1 (a draft), then add chapters.
creator.orphans: Chapters without a season: {numbers}. A chapter always belongs to a season – add them to {file}.
creator.not_loaded: The toon's content is not loaded yet. Reload the page and try again.
creator.chapters_adopted: Existing chapters added to the season as draft: {numbers}.
creator.reader_uses_season: The reader shows the season's title and description on the toon page; the chapters' status (per language) decides which are listed and readable. The cover (square, one image for every language, in the cover editor) is the toon page's cover, its lettering in the reader's language. The trailer loop comes in up to three qualities (480p / 720p / 1080p); readers get the one their quality setting picks. Authors and release date are not shown yet; the credits page shows the toon's credits.
creator.reader_uses_toon: The reader shows title and description on the toon page and the title on the download page (downloads and covers belong to the seasons). The same in every language: the tile and “Announce” on the homepage and in the menu, the map's start view; authors, chapter count and thumbnail are not used by the reader. Per language: title, description, release date and status.
creator.format_hint: SCUTOONS slice: 390 × 624 px (at 3x exactly one WEBTOON image, 800 × 1280), delivered at 1x as WebP in the chapter's folder (<toon>/s1/c2/s1c2-slice-N.webp) – other heights are fine, the width stays 390. Text-free art, the words are text boxes.
creator.draw_hint: Drag on the image to draw a text box. Arrows nudge, Shift+arrows ×10, Delete removes.
creator.select_slice: Select a slice on the left.
creator.text_language_hint: Content language of the translatable fields (titles, descriptions, dialogue) – not the interface language. One language at a time, the source (★) by default; a translation shows the original under each field.
creator.text_copy_hint: Copy the {locale} text into this field (replaces its content)
creator.languages_hint: The source language is the one the toon is written in; the others are translations of it. Every editor of this toon (texts, missing translations, length warnings, VN events, new chapters) follows these settings.
creator.remove_language_message: The {locale} texts stay stored in every chapter; the editor just stops showing and checking them. Add {locale} again and they are back. Readers only see a change once it is published.
creator.make_source_message: {locale} becomes the source language of the whole toon instead of {source}: the creator shows it first, missing translations are checked against it, and readers without a text in their language get the {locale} text. Nothing is deleted. Saved as a draft of the toon settings – readers notice it only once it is published.
creator.languages_unsaved: Save the draft to use the new languages in the editors.
creator.languages_remove_note: Removing a language keeps its texts; the editors just stop showing them.
creator.clip_no_target: Open a slice or select where to paste first
creator.clip_no_settings: Nothing selected to paste the settings onto
creator.clip_settings_kind: The settings of {what} don't fit the selection
creator.clip_empty: Nothing to paste – copy something in the creator first
creator.clip_limit: {item}: only {limit} placements allowed – {count} with this paste ({where})
creator.credits_open_hint: People and their roles – shown on the reader's credits page
creator.credits_lead_hint: Shown first and prominently on the credits page.
creator.credits_entries: Credits (grouped by role category on the page)
creator.credits_people_hint: {count} people in the shared registry (all toons).
creator.credits_merge_confirm: Merge “{from}” into “{to}”? {count} references in this toon are replaced; the name becomes an alias.
creator.credits_registry_hint: The registry is shared by every toon: changes show up in all credits after publishing.
creator.credits_custom_roles_hint: Only this toon uses them (saved with its credits).
creator.credits_vocabulary_hint: The role vocabulary of all toons.
creator.cast_hint: Who appears in each season of this toon, with which personas, in order, each with a role per language. Characters live in the shared registry (all toons) – a character with its own toon can join other casts too.
creator.cast_open_hint: The toon's characters – used by the VN scripts
creator.characters_available: file on the CDN, path not set
creator.characters_home_hint: Every character of every toon: names, personas, looks, moods, A-poses
creator.characters_no_toon: No toon (no cast, no own toon)
creator.characters_pick: Pick a character on the left, or create a new one.
creator.characters_import_hint: Choose the character's files, named by the convention: {id}_portrait-neutral.png, {id}_avatar-happy.png, {id}_full-neutral.png, a look {id}_helmet_portrait-…, a persona {id}-biker_portrait-…, the A-pose {id}_apose.png, a transition {id}_transition-helmet-to-default.png. Each goes onto its slot as WebP; a file already there gets the new version.
creator.characters_import_no_slot: the name names no slot – e.g. {example}
creator.characters_import_other: the name is for "{name}", not this character
creator.characters_import_unknown_look: the transition needs the look "{name}" – add it first
creator.characters_import_unknown_persona: this character has no persona "{name}" – add it first
creator.characters_remove_look_confirm: Remove the look “{look}” and its image paths?
creator.characters_remove_used: It is in the cast of {toons}.
creator.characters_glossary: Persona, look, mood, view – what is what?
creator.characters_glossary_persona: A different identity or role of the same being (Cat Pope · human, · cat, · Biker) – it changes who they are in the story. Every character has the persona “regular”.
creator.characters_glossary_look: The appearance right now: outfit, gear, accessories – it can change within a scene (helmet on/off). Rule of thumb: if it could come off in the next panel, it's a look; if it changes who they are in the story, it's a persona. One default look per persona.
creator.characters_glossary_mood: The expression. The vocabulary is open (Moods tab); only neutral is required – the standard set is a checklist.
creator.characters_glossary_view: The framing: only the portrait is drawn; the avatar is a 192px copy of it, full is not used. In the data still called “variant”. The A-pose (avatar body for members) belongs to the character, not to a persona.
creator.characters_glossary_fallback: When an image is missing, the reader steps back one step at a time (other views first use the portrait): persona + look + mood → same look neutral → persona's default look + mood → its neutral → regular persona's default look + mood → its neutral → the single image.
creator.characters_model_mannequin: None yet – the placeholder (mannequin) for the body below is shown.
creator.characters_model_hint: This persona's 3D model (storyboard). A look can have its own.
creator.characters_apose_hint: Every look can have an A-pose: the members' avatar body in this look. Full body, neutral, 768 × 1152. Worn items are not drawn on the body – they sit in the avatar page's slots.
creator.characters_avatar_derived: The avatar is a 192px downscale of the portrait (generated)
creator.characters_glossary_character: The being in the SCUTOONS universe (an own toon is optional). Name, description, color, voice, tags, artwork and the A-pose belong here.
creator.characters_stage_fallback: not drawn yet – shows the nearest
creator.characters_stage_fallback_hint: This mood / view has no picture of its own yet; the stage shows the one the reader would get (the fallback rule).
creator.characters_regular_hint: The regular persona is the character itself – its name and fields are the character’s (tap the head).
creator.characters_model_pick_level: A 3D model belongs to a persona or a look – tap one above.
creator.characters_moods_hint: Every mood of every character: add as many as you like, name them per language, order them. ★ standard marks the checklist a look should cover – never required, only neutral is (the fallback anchor).
creator.characters_note_hint: Creates an asset request for {file} – listed under “Wanted images”. VN scripts keep working with the fallback.
creator.characters_path_missing_hint: Not on the CDN yet – the path can be saved anyway (upload the file in the asset manager).
creator.characters_picker_all_moods: show every mood of the vocabulary
creator.characters_picker_will_add: not in the cast of {season} – picking adds it
creator.characters_remove_mood_confirm: Remove the mood “{mood}” from the vocabulary? {count} looks have an image for it (the images stay).
creator.characters_remove_persona_confirm: Remove the persona “{persona}” with its looks?
creator.characters_wanted_hint: Missing portraits of the standard set, missing A-poses and every note – with the file name the image should get. Copy the list to brief the image supplier. (Interim until images can be uploaded to the CDN from the creator.)
creator.characters_persona_color: Color of the persona (else the character's)
creator.slice_sensitive_hint: Readers with “Hide sensitive content” on see it blurred and muted.
creator.video_player_hint: Video player: sound and controls, no loop / autoplay; the slice gets the video's aspect ratio
creator.video_hint: Plays muted and inline, looping, while the slice is in view (poster only with reduced motion). H.264 MP4, a new file name for every new version: <name>.480p.mp4 / .720p.mp4 / .1080p.mp4. The image below is the poster.
creator.video_controls_hint: Show the browser's basic controls (play/pause, time, volume, fullscreen). Without them a click on the video plays and pauses the player.
creator.video_full_viewport_hint: The slice fills the whole screen (full width, screen height) instead of the reading column; the video and its poster are placed in it like this. The aspect ratio doesn't apply here.
creator.video_fit_contain_hint: The whole video is visible, as large as possible; black bars where it doesn't fill.
creator.video_fit_cover_hint: The video always fills the whole area; the overflow is cropped.
creator.video_fit_width_hint: The video is as wide as the area; a taller one is cropped at the top/bottom, a flatter one gets bars above/below.
creator.video_fit_height_hint: The video is as high as the area; a wider one is cropped at the sides, a narrower one gets bars left/right.
creator.video_frame_hint: The slice's area in the reading column (390 px wide, the height follows). The video is placed in it with “All”, “Fill”, “Width” or “Height”.
creator.video_original_mismatch: The poster and the video have different aspect ratios – with "Original" the slice shifts while loading. Adjust the poster or choose an aspect ratio.
creator.slice_size: Size {width} × {height} px (read from the image; standard {standard})
creator.help_home: Pick a toon to edit its languages, seasons, chapters, credits and cast. The top bar always shows where you are; the sidebar lists what is inside. Characters, moods and wanted images (Universe) are shared by every toon. Alt+Up / Alt+Down go up or down a level.
creator.help_saving: Save draft stores your changes as a draft – only creators see drafts (preview). Publish makes the newest version live in the reader. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo. Unsaved edits stay in this browser and are offered back after a reload.
creator.help_problems: Problems (in the bar) lists the errors and warnings of everything on the page; click one to jump to it. Publishing with errors asks first.
creator.help_chapter_tree: Left: the chapter tree – Meta, Audio and the groups with their slices. Select a slice to edit it on the canvas; the inspector on the right has its text boxes, items, audio, events and image. Alt+Up / Alt+Down go up or down a level.
creator.help_canvas: The slice is shown at its 1x size (390 px wide), scaled down when the column is narrower. Tools: ▭ text box / ♪ sample area – drag on empty space to draw one. The grid snaps positions. Position and size are the same in every language; only the text is per language.
creator.help_audio_chapter: Music and samples are shared by every language. Slices set music volumes and trigger samples (select a slice → Audio). Paths are relative to the toon's CDN folder (e.g. audio/music/s1c1-instrumental.128.mp3). Renaming an id does not rename its uses in slices – the problem list shows them.
creator.help_audio_slice: Samples play on scroll (when the slice comes into view) or on a click in an area. Draw the area with the ♪ sample area tool, or drag it on the slice.
creator.help_group: A group is a part of the chapter: its slices are read one below the other (Layout: Vertical), side by side as you scroll down (Horizontal) or in an endless band you drag sideways (Endless). A VN script plays visual-novel events over the group; slice events start when their slice comes into view or on a click in their area.
creator.help_credits: Sections on the left, the live preview per language on the right. People and roles have their own tabs.
creator.help_guide: The rules for art, lettering, characters and credits in one place. The Info panel of every creator page links here.
creator.characters_transition_hint: A transition is an image shown while the look changes (e.g. taking the helmet off).
creator.group_continues_hint: The next group follows on the same page, no bar in between.
creator.next_label_hint: This group can jump away and continues into the next group, which has no label – nothing can lead back to it.
creator.reach_loop_hint: From here the script only goes round – no end, no jump.
creator.reach_stuck_hint: The reader may get stuck here: every choice has a condition, all of them can be hidden at once. Give one choice no condition (e.g. "Go on") – it won’t save otherwise.
creator.reach_never_hint: This test can never pass: its variable is set nowhere (in no toon).
creator.reach_unreachable_hint: Nothing leads here: the content before it always leaves (jumpTo) or never finishes, and no jump or divert comes here. Delete it or give it a way in.
creator.flow_open: Story flow – what leads where. Read-only: a box opens its place in the editor; drag to pan, wheel or the buttons to zoom.
creator.flow_season_open: The season's flow – chapters, jumps, ends. Read-only: a box opens its chapter; drag to pan, wheel or the buttons to zoom.
creator.flow_toon_open: The toon's flow – seasons, chapters, map, jumps. Read-only: a box opens its chapter; drag to pan, wheel or the buttons to zoom.
creator.flow_universe_hint: Every toon and the jumps between them, from the newest versions (drafts included). A box opens the toon’s flow.
creator.flow_once_hint: runs at most once per reader (once for good)
creator.flow_entry: Entry point: a jump, an end or a map place from outside leads to this label
creator.group_end_hint: Where the reader goes after this group, instead of the next group or chapter.
creator.group_end_auto_hint: Straight there once the group is read – no bar, no countdown.
creator.reader_open: The reader in the dock: the saved drafts on a phone (or a desktop), at the group / slice open here; it reloads after every save.
creator.prompts_hint: For another AI (an image generator) or a human artist, filled in for the persona and look shown above: copy, attach the image named in the first line, send. Deliveries come back through the image import.
creator.chapter_number_hint: Chapter number = its address {path} and its place in the release order. Given when the chapter is created; it never changes.
creator.featuring_hint: Who appears in this chapter (from the season cast) – shown in the reader on the chapter list and at the chapter start.
creator.featuring_suggest_hint: The toon’s star and everyone the chapter’s VN scripts use
creator.cast_star_locked: The toon’s star is always in the cast
creator.cast_last_persona: At least one persona: tick another one first
creator.status_where: The status is changed only on the chapter page (Meta); the toon page and the season show it read-only.
creator.cast_star_hint: The toon’s star is always in the cast (added automatically, cannot be removed). Seasons are created on the toon page; who appears in a chapter is set on the chapter page (Featuring).
creator.script_missing_locale: No {locale} script yet. Translations may be partial – the {source} script is the master.
creator.script_edit_confirm: The script is read-only so it is not changed by accident. Only edit it if you know the format rules – changes are saved as a draft and published like every other edit.
creator.script_rules_intro: The screenplay follows the format of the screenplay editor; the outline reads the headings with its rules.
creator.scripts_intro: The screenplays: one per season (how Cat Pope was written) and one per chapter (how Top Toy is written), and the toon's Kanon text. Working material – readers never see them.
creator.map_kanon_hint: The place's Kanon text: its backstory and its scenery – what the generators, the map pictures and artists read
creator.kanon_not_a_section: not a section of this text
creator.kanon_unknown_subject: No Kanon text has this address: {subject}
creator.kanon_edit_confirm: The Kanon is read-only so it is not changed by accident. Changes are saved as a draft; publishing makes them Kanon – what the generators, the artist briefs and the MCP read.
creator.kanon_missing_locale: No {locale} text yet. Translations may be partial – the {source} text is the master.
creator.kanon_rules_intro: A line "## <heading>" opens a section; every section is optional, the order is fixed, headings work in German and English. Text before the first heading is an intro.
creator.help_kanon: The Kanon: the story text behind a toon, a character, a persona, a look or a place – one text per language (the source language is the master), working material for the team, readers never see it. Publishing makes it Kanon: the generators, the artist briefs and the MCP read the published text.
creator.script_rule_chapter: “# <n>. Kapitel” – a chapter; the next “# …” lines are its title and subtitle (translations may write “Chapter”).
creator.script_rule_scene: “<n>   INT./EXT. PLACE - TIME” – a scene heading at the start of the line, numbered through the whole script, in capitals; only inside a chapter.
creator.script_rule_character: Character: indented by 25–30 spaces, in CAPITALS; tags like (V.O.), (O.S.), (cont’d), (subtitle).
creator.script_rule_parenthetical: Parenthetical: “(whispering)” on its own line between the character and the dialogue.
creator.script_rule_dialogue: Dialogue: indented by 16 spaces (2 tabs), right after the character.
creator.script_rule_transition: Transition: indented by 48 spaces, in CAPITALS.
creator.script_rule_song: “# <n>. Lied” – a song (or “Song”); its title on the next “# …” line; the lyrics (with labels like “1. Strophe”, “Chorus”) run until the next chapter, song or page break.
creator.script_rule_break: “---” (three or more dashes) – a page break.
creator.script_rule_whitespace: Every space, tab and blank line is part of the format and is saved exactly as typed. Tab inserts 4 spaces; Esc, then Tab leaves the text.
creator.script_rule_source: The full writing guide: the README of the screenplay editor ({path}).
creator.help_script: One screenplay per toon (not per chapter), one text per language: the source language is the master, translations may be partial. It is working material for the team – readers never see it. Save draft, Publish and the history work like everywhere else; restore brings back an old version exactly.
creator.restore_confirm_when: Restore the version of {when} as a new draft of {locale}?
creator.trailer_hint: A muted loop behind the toon page title (desktop); "Watch the trailer" and "Sound on" open the trailer chapter (default 0, the prologue). The same in every language.
creator.landing_hint: The toon’s avatar and tile on scutoons.com and in the menu. Without a tile image the tile shows the avatar. The same in every language.
creator.announce_hint: Show it on the homepage and in the menu before it is published – as “soon”, no link, no chapters, no dates.
creator.toon_neutral_hint: Once for the toon, not per language: authors, chapter count, thumbnail, the homepage tile and the map. Covers belong to the seasons.
creator.toon_status_hint: Per language: a language that isn’t published has no toon page in it and isn’t listed on the homepage in it. A language without its own status has the source’s.
creator.toon_entry_missing: This toon has no settings yet – set its languages on the toon page and save:
creator.cover_mode_hint_off: The image is shown as it is – for art that still has its title baked in.
creator.cover_mode_hint_default: The toon's name small, the season's title big in quotes. Drag a line to start your own layout from it.
creator.cover_mode_hint_custom: Drag a line to move it; the handles change its width (side), size (corner) and angle (top). Arrow keys nudge it (Shift: 5 %).
creator.cover_text_hint: Texts come from the text fields (toon settings, season) – one layout for every language.
creator.cover_art_hint: One image for every language, chosen once. The reader sets the lettering over it.
creator.cover_no_art: No square image yet – choose it under Art.
creator.cover_help: The season's cover is one text-free image for every language. The reader sets the lettering over it in the reader's language: each line takes its text from a text field (the toon's title, the season's title, or its own text per language) and shrinks to fit its width, so long translations stay on the art. Off = the image as it is (art with its title baked in). The toon page shows the cover of the season it presents (square).
creator.cover_no_season: This season doesn't exist yet – create it on the toon page:
creator.map_start_view: Start view on the world map
creator.map_start_view_hint: The toon's start view: zoom and pan until the phone frame in the middle shows what readers see first – then set it (in the toon settings, the same in every language).
creator.region_representative_hint: A character of the region; elections come later. Without one the narrator says the greeting.
creator.map_route_endpoint_hint: A route starts and ends at a place.
creator.map_route_new_place_hint: Name it afterwards in its panel
creator.map_id_locked: Fixed since it was published (events reference the id)
creator.map_unlock_hint: The place appears once a reader has read the chapter up to this point (0 = its start, 100 = its end). Scene = the screenplay scene.
creator.map_chapter_link: Button on the place card: read chapter …
creator.map_import_hint: Choose place illustrations named after the place id (e.g. old-church.png; old-church-plaster.png for the plaster model; .2x / .3x in the name for a size): each becomes that place's image in the media standard – WebP in 1x / 2x / 3x (256 / 512 / 1024 px, the smaller ones made from a bigger file) – in the place illustrations' folder; a file already there gets the new version.
creator.map_import_plaster_first: the plaster model needs the painted image first
creator.map_image_anchor_hint: Click or drag on the image: this point sits on the centre of the place's tiles.
creator.map_image_plaster_hint: The same diorama unpainted, framed like the painted image (same size and ground point). When the story unlocks the place, the reader’s map fades from the plaster model to the painted one.
creator.map_hidden_by_event: Hidden until the story unlocks it: an unlockLocation event (in a VN script, on a slice or an item) in any toon.
creator.map_hidden_never_unlocked: “{name}” is hidden and no unlockLocation event unlocks it – readers never see it.
creator.map_delete_confirm_events: Delete “{name}”? {count} document(s) have unlockLocation events for it – they will do nothing then.
creator.map_used_in_events: Story events come with the map events.
creator.map_delete_blocked: On routes ({routes}) – remove it there first.
creator.map_insert_hint: Click the selected route's line to insert a free point; points can be dragged.
creator.map_move_shared_place: “{name}” is a place (maybe on other routes too) – move it?
creator.map_layer_fog: Fog of war: only around unlocked places (world units, empty = everywhere)
creator.map_layer_fog_hint: For the painted layer over the plaster model – the reader shows it only where the reader has been; here in the builder whole.
creator.map_world_size: World size (px of the terrain art)
creator.map_bounded_hint: The reader's map zooms out only until the terrain fills the screen and stops at its edges. Off: readers may zoom further out and move past the edge (for a map bigger than its terrain art).
creator.map_help: The one world map of every toon: places, routes (with free waypoints) and layers. Save and publish at the bottom like everywhere. Tools: Select V (click, drag; arrow keys move by 1, with Shift by 10), + Place P, Draw route R. Pan: the middle mouse button, Space + drag or a drag on the empty terrain; the wheel or two fingers zoom. The toon chips filter the map; Reader view greys what a reader doesn't see at the start, on their toon's sea; the phone frame shows a reader's screen (375 × 812).
creator.map_help_ids: Ids are the addresses story events use: editable until the first publish, fixed afterwards.
creator.map_help_images: Place images: transparent WebP, 256 × 256 px, ≤ 40 KB (60 KB at most), ground point bottom centre (50 / 90 %), at <toon>/images/map/places/<id>.webp (a place without an image is listed in “Wanted images → Map places”, with the prompt).
creator.map_unlock_stale: The point no longer matches the slice ({now} % instead of {at} %)
creator.map_unlock_missing: The slice is no longer in this chapter
creator.map_place_view_hint: Where the reader's map centres on the place (the reader's place, ◎): zoom 3–400 % and a shift. Empty: the place at 100 %.
creator.map_place_view_use_hint: Stores the canvas's zoom and its centre as the shift from the place
creator.map_gates_hint: Where routes run into and out of the diorama – entry: {entry}, exit: {exit}. Drag a gate on the map (with the place selected) to place it.
creator.map_curve_reset_hint: drag it to shape how the route runs; double-click: back to computed
creator.map_cells_painted: {count} cells painted – routes, gates and clicks use them.
creator.map_cells_computed: Computed from the size – paint to set the cells the diorama stands on.
creator.slice_unlocks_hint: When a reader reaches this slice, the place appears on the map – the same setting as in the world map (stored there, published with this chapter).
creator.slice_unlocks_no_image: The slice needs an image (it is its address).
creator.map_go_view: Go to the view (the place’s, else the start view)
creator.migrate_hint: Registers the reader's avatar or a character in the region. Then the welcome: the town sign, the elected representative says the region's greeting – without one, the narrator. The script waits until the welcome is closed.
creator.unlock_location_hint: The reader gets a toast “<place> unlocked” – a tap on it (or on the new place in the map) plays the reveal. Map: “By the trigger” opens it in a VN script, a click trigger or an item tap, and shows only the toast when scrolled into; “Open” always opens it and plays the reveal; “Toast only” never opens it. Silent: the state only.
creator.set_avatar_location_hint: The reader is here now: their avatar stands at the place, and walking on the map starts from there. No toast. Only a place the reader can already see – for a hidden one, put an unlockLocation before it.
creator.map_start_view_none: {toon}: no start view (centre of the places)
creator.wanted_map_prompt: Brief (for an image generator or a designer; attach the style references)
creator.related_items_hint_season: Items that go with the season, in this order – the toon page shows them (physical products with a link to buy). The same in every language.
creator.related_items_hint_chapter: Items that go with the chapter, in this order. The same in every language; the reader does not show them yet.
creator.trailer_chapter_hint: "Watch the trailer" / "Sound on" open this chapter (default 0, the prologue)
creator.cover_open_hint: Open the cover editor: art and lettering
creator.season_music_from_album: The season's music (download, the record beside the music button) comes from the album of a related record in the item catalog – its zip and its cover.
creator.field_keyvisual_legacy: The key visual is stored in the old format.
creator.anchor_hint: The point X / Y place – the box grows away from it (more lines, another language, a picture’s ratio)
creator.text_paragraphs_hint: Paragraphs (a list) – click for one text
creator.text_mask_legacy: Mask (deprecated – only for art with text in it)
creator.group_name_hint: The group's address: links (?label=) and jumps lead here.
creator.group_layout_hint: Vertical: the slices one below the other. Horizontal: side by side at the screen's full height; scrolling down moves them sideways. Endless: side by side in a screen-high band you drag sideways; it goes round without end.
creator.music_silent_hint: silent – no earlier slice sets it
creator.sample_not_in_library: “{id}” is not in the chapter's sample library – pick its file.
creator.samples_misplaced: {count} samples are in the wrong place and never play.
creator.target_toon_hint: A chapter of another toon: the jump lands at the chosen group there. Variables belong to each toon – there, the other toon's apply.
creator.text_size_hint: Font size – the unit (%, px, pt, rem of the slice at 1x) is chosen in the field; stored relative to the slice width, so it scales with the slice
creator.colour_eyedropper: Pick a colour from the screen
creator.colour_eyedropper_slice: Pick a colour from the slice
creator.paint_gradient_stops: Gradient stops – click the bar to add one
creator.pick_hint: Tap a point of the slice – Esc cancels
creator.pick_unreadable: The slice picture can't be read – Esc cancels
creator.fit_width: Auto width – the box hugs its text, wraps only at a max width
creator.fit_height: Auto height – fixed width, the text wraps, the box grows
creator.fit_fixed: Fixed size – the text shrinks to fit, then runs past the box
creator.collage_shapes_error: The shapes could not be loaded: {error}
creator.collage_shapes_empty: No shapes yet – shapes come from the asset manager's vector library (SVG assets with a shape).
creator.collage_no_picture: No picture of {name} to place yet – add one under Characters.
creator.piece_view_missing: No “{view}” picture of {mood} yet – add one under Characters.
creator.preset_update_confirm: Every piece with this preset – on every toon's slices and every score – changes with it once the presets are published.
creator.preset_delete_confirm: “{name}” leaves the list – pieces that use it keep drawing it.
creator.piece_gradient_angle: Gradient direction ° (0 = to the top, 180 = top to bottom)
creator.piece_shadow_x: Shadow offset X (% of the piece)
creator.piece_shadow_y: Shadow offset Y (% of the piece)
creator.piece_blur_ramp: Ramp – sharp at the start, blurred from the end
creator.piece_blur_from_x: Sharp at X % of the piece
creator.piece_blur_from_y: Sharp at Y % of the piece
creator.piece_blur_to_x: Blurred from X % of the piece
creator.piece_blur_to_y: Blurred from Y % of the piece
creator.piece_at_bar: The music – a bar and its staff (moves with the bar)
creator.piece_at_page: The page that holds the bar (a background)
creator.piece_bar: Bar number as the file writes it
creator.piece_y_sp: Y – staff spaces below the staff's top line
creator.tool_piece: Piece – click on the slice to place a shape or a character picture there, drag to give it a width
creator.layers_pieces_under: Pieces always lie under the text boxes and items – drag them among the pieces.
creator.piece_blur_from_dot: Sharp at this point – drag it
creator.piece_blur_to_dot: Blurred from this point on – drag it
creator.score_failed: The score could not be loaded.
creator.catalog_collage_hint: Place shapes and character pictures on the score – they stick to their bars on every screen
creator.collage_stage_no_score: This item has no score file – add its MusicXML in the catalog first.
creator.collage_stage_unsigned: The score file could not be opened – the stage shows the published file: publish the item first.
creator.collage_stage_no_page: The score is still being laid out – try again in a moment.
creator.collage_missing_bar: Bar {bar} is not in the file – readers don't see this piece
creator.collage_sides: Pieces over the notes and behind them are ordered on their own side – switch a piece's side in the inspector.
creator.collage_file_changed: The pieces were placed on another file – check that they sit on the right bars.
creator.event_ids_assigned: {files}: {count} events have no hidden id yet (the readers’ save game remembers events by it) – the next save stores them.
creator.ask_scope_toon: a story variable (the same in every toon)
creator.ask_scope_reader_hint: Texts show it as reader.name – on every toon; readers can change it on their account page.
creator.vn_condition_expr_hint: ink logic, e.g. count("e…") < 3 and not has("cucumber")
creator.catalog_hint: Items, recipes, albums, products, editions – each entry its own document with versions
creator.catalog_help: Every catalog entry is its own document: Save stores a draft, its versions are in the History, Publish is the same list as everywhere. Only publishing puts the entry into the catalog readers get.
creator.catalog_help_physical: Physical changes (a physical item, an edition, a product, max in the world, recipes that make such an item, owners-only albums, products, editions) are published only by accounts with the admin rule "Publishes physical items" for the toon – everyone else submits them for review. An edition on an item makes it an option of every unclaimed code of that edition.
creator.catalog_new_hint: The id stays forever (lower case, digits, _ and -). The entry is a draft until it is published.
creator.catalog_physical_hint: Publishing needs the rule "Publishes physical items" – otherwise it goes to review
creator.catalog_physical_note: Physical: published only with the rule "Publishes physical items" for this toon – otherwise it is submitted for review.
creator.catalog_remove_never_published: The entry was never published: it is deleted, its id is free again.
creator.catalog_remove_published: The entry gets a "removed" version – a draft. Only publishing it takes it out of the catalog (not while something uses it); its id stays taken.
creator.catalog_import_hint: Files <id>.png or <id>_<variant>.png: become WebP and go onto the item (or recipe) – as a draft, published with the list
creator.catalog_removed_note: Removed: publishing takes the entry out of the catalog (its id stays taken). "Keep it" under More takes this back.
creator.sound_new_module_hint: The id stays forever (lower case, digits, _ and -). It starts as the walk module and is a draft until it is published.
creator.sound_id_invalid: "{id}" is not a valid module id.
creator.sound_pick_module: Pick a module above, or create a new one with +.
creator.sound_play_note: The deck plays the character's rig. Playing the compiled module in the engine comes next.
creator.sound_cant_edit_hint: There is no editor for {key} yet. Character rigs (rig:character.<id>) and modules (module:<id>) open in Sound design.
creator.sound_publish_confirm: Publish module:{id}? Readers get the published version.
creator.sound_publish_needs: Publish needs a saved draft with a current compile.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.keys: ↑↓ move · Enter open · Esc close · Ctrl K or / anywhere
palette.placeholder: Type a toon, a chapter or a page …

storyboard.editor_variants_hint: Variants – every generation of the picked shots, a band each (V)
storyboard.board_label: Every generation of the picked shots – one band each, in toon order
storyboard.board_keys: Click: the current card (its shot current) · Ctrl + click: select (A–D) · C: Compare (open: a click fills an empty side, else replaces the last, A stays; Space plays the videos on one clock) · arrows move (strips and folded bands skipped) · Enter chosen · R review · X reject – it folds to a strip (again: back) · I improve on this – fills Generate (nothing is sent) · a click on a strip: a look into it (Esc closes it) · wheel: down through the bands, Shift + wheel: sideways, a drag on the background: pan · Ctrl + wheel / + / −: zoom · 0: fit · Esc: Compare closes, then the selection · V: the Viewport
storyboard.board_keys_short: click current · Ctrl + click select · C compare · arrows · Enter ✓ · R ? · X ✕ · I ⚡ · + − 0 zoom
storyboard.board_show_rejected_hint: Unfold every rejected card in every band (off: each folds to a strip in its place)
storyboard.board_zoom_hint: Back to 100 % · 0: fit the widest band · Ctrl + wheel: about the pointer
storyboard.board_add: Add images or videos to {shot} – or drop them onto a band
storyboard.board_added: {n} file(s) added to {shot} – source cards in its band.
storyboard.board_band_hint: {shot} – a click in its band makes it the current shot. Drop images or videos onto the band: source cards for {shot}.
storyboard.board_band_folded: {shot} – folded: a click on the line unfolds it (the keys skip it, it loads nothing)
storyboard.board_fold: Fold the band to this line
storyboard.board_cards: {shot}'s cards – the arrows move, Enter chosen, R review, X reject
storyboard.board_render_hint: {shot} · the shot as drawn here – Improve on it: the shot's own inputs
storyboard.board_take_hint: {shot} · take {take} – its results hang under it
storyboard.board_running_hint: from {from} – its result lands here. Cancel: the Generate panel's jobs.
storyboard.board_strip_hint: Rejected {when}: {names}. Click / Enter: unfold it for a look · X: back, as that X folded it
storyboard.board_strip_label: {name} – rejected; Enter: a look into it, X: back
storyboard.board_rejected_first: {name} is rejected – X brings it back first.
storyboard.board_rejected_out: {name} is rejected – it stays out of Compare (X brings it back).
storyboard.board_chosen_kept: {name} is the chosen – choose another first.
storyboard.board_drop_kept: {name} is a source (dropped) – it can't be rejected.
storyboard.board_rejected_with: {name} rejected with {n} under it – X again brings them back.
storyboard.board_compare_select: Select 2–4 cards to compare (Ctrl + click) – then C.
storyboard.status_label: {name}: status – the pressed one; pressed again: none
storyboard.status_choose: Chosen – {name} becomes the shot's chosen of its kind (Enter)
storyboard.status_chosen_hint: {name} is the chosen (one per kind: choosing another replaces it)
storyboard.status_review_hint: Review – to look at again / a change asked (R); pressed again: none
storyboard.status_reject_hint: Rejected – with what hangs under it (not the chosen); pressed again brings them back (X)
storyboard.improve_hint: Improve on {name} – fills Generate; nothing is sent before Generate (I)
storyboard.vary_hint: Vary {name} – its own inputs, prompt and model with a new seed: a sibling in its row; fills Generate
storyboard.improve_line_hint: A board card fills the form – Generate asks with the cost before anything is sent
storyboard.improve_clear: Back to the shot's own inputs
storyboard.improve_how_video_key: {name} as the video – the chosen image as the keyframe
storyboard.improve_how_video_nokey: {name} as the video – no keyframe (no chosen image)
storyboard.improve_how_vary: its own inputs, prompt and model – a sibling in its row
storyboard.improve_how_none: this model takes no card like {name} – pick another model
storyboard.improve_switched: {generator}: the generator before takes no such card
storyboard.improve_seed_hint: New: the provider picks one · the card's: the same seed again – with another prompt, a controlled change
storyboard.improve_no_source: A source has no record – Improve on it instead.
storyboard.improve_no_dropped: {name} was dropped – no generator to vary it with (Improve on it instead).
storyboard.improve_no_generator: {name} came from a generator this page doesn't offer.
storyboard.improve_no_model: {name}'s model is not offered any more.
storyboard.improve_no_running: A running job has no result yet.
storyboard.improve_no_start: {model} takes no start frame or keyframe – pick an image to video model (Gen-4) or Aleph 2 in Generate.
storyboard.improve_no_file: {name}: its file can't be read here.
storyboard.improve_used: {name} is the still in Generate – nothing is sent before Generate.
storyboard.improve_frame_done: {name} – the frame – is the still in Generate.
storyboard.more_at_unset: Still: the frame at … (click the card)
storyboard.more_pin_hint: Click {name} where you want the frame (it scrubs under the pointer) – that moment is pinned
storyboard.more_frame_hint: That frame of {name}, cut here and kept as an image of the shot, becomes Generate's still – nothing is sent before Generate
storyboard.more_use_hint: {name} becomes Generate's still – the rest of the form stays; nothing is sent before Generate
storyboard.more_no_model: {model} doesn't take it – pick a model in Generate
storyboard.more_compare_hint: The selection = Compare's sides A–D (Ctrl + click does the same; C opens Compare)
storyboard.compare_label: Compare – the selected cards side by side
storyboard.compare_open_hint: Compare the {n} selected side by side (C) – fewer than two: the shot's chosen as A
storyboard.compare_resize: Resize Compare – the bands get the rest (Home: its normal width)
storyboard.compare_hole: Click a card – it comes in as {letter}
storyboard.compare_reference: A – the reference: it stays while a click on a card replaces the last side
storyboard.compare_play: Play – every side on one clock (Space)
storyboard.compare_scrub: The time – every side at the same moment (← → 0.1 s, Shift 1 s)
storyboard.title: Storyboard
storyboard.missing: This chapter has no storyboard yet.
storyboard.no_shot: Pick a shot on the left.
storyboard.step_script_hint: The scene’s script next to the shot – what each shot shows
storyboard.step_shots_hint: The shots in order – what each shows
storyboard.step_generate_hint: The shot’s generations: look, mark, approve and share
storyboard.image_hint: The picture in English, for the generators’ prompts
storyboard.source_hint: What the final image should be
storyboard.camera_shot_hint: Size and angle – the shot camera
storyboard.lens_hint: The hand camera (set in the 3D view)
storyboard.preset_camera: The camera comes from size and angle.
storyboard.scene_light: Scene: {light} – an empty field takes the scene’s.
storyboard.light_direction_hint: A free direction instead of From: azimuth 0 = from the camera, 90 = right, 180 = behind; elevation
storyboard.softness_hint: 0 = Sin City hard (solid black shadows) … 1 = soft (hatched shadows, a fill)
storyboard.rim_hint: A rim light behind the figures
storyboard.place_hint: x / y on the screen (0…1), the height in screens
storyboard.add_figure_hint: A figure from the scene’s cast
storyboard.list_hint: Click: only this shot · Ctrl + click: add / take off · Shift + click: the shots up to here
storyboard.workspace_hint: Your attempts live in this folder on your computer – they are never uploaded by themselves.
storyboard.workspace_allow_hint: After a restart the browser asks again whether the page may use the folder.
storyboard.workspace_unsupported: The workspace folder needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.
storyboard.gen_share_hint: Upload to the shared work storage so the others can see it (not the CDN)
storyboard.gen_approve_hint: Approve as the shot’s chosen one – another click takes it back
storyboard.gen_not_set_up_hint: Not set up – the admin adds {setting} to the server’s configuration.
storyboard.gen_manual_note: Free, no API: copy the prompt into lumalabs.ai, attach the references, drop the result below.
storyboard.gen_load_error: The generators can’t be read: {error} – Luma by hand still works.
storyboard.gen_build_hint: Everything set for this shot – also unsaved changes – as one prompt (replaces the text below)
storyboard.gen_still_hint: A generation of this shot to start from (Luma edits it, Runway animates it)
storyboard.gen_control_hint: The video it follows (a generated clip of this shot)
storyboard.gen_characters_hint: The figures’ character images on the CDN, sent as references
storyboard.gen_character_http: Only public https links reach the provider – this CDN is local.
storyboard.gen_local_ref: only in your folder – Send shares it first
storyboard.gen_generate_hint: Asks with the cost before anything is sent
storyboard.gen_confirm_message: {model} · about {cost} ({figures}). Booked on the generation budget – {left} of {budget} left. Nothing is retried by itself.
storyboard.gen_budget_exhausted: Budget used up: {spent} of {budget} – ask the owner to raise it
storyboard.gen_no_budget: No generation budget set – the admin sets it in Settings
storyboard.gen_cancel_hint: Stop the job at the provider (a running one costs its estimate)
storyboard.gen_result_pick_folder: Choose a workspace folder to keep it – the provider’s link runs out (Luma’s after an hour).
storyboard.gen_save_hint: The result into your workspace folder – the record names the file and this computer
storyboard.gen_copied: Prompt copied – paste it into Luma.
storyboard.gen_result_slot: Drop Luma’s result here – or pick it
storyboard.gen_result_slot_hint: The picture or clip you made on lumalabs.ai – saved into your workspace folder and recorded with this prompt (png, jpeg, webp, mp4, webm)
storyboard.gen_needs_folder: Choose a workspace folder first – the result is saved there.
storyboard.machine_hint: This computer’s name on the records of files saved here (default: “this browser”)
storyboard.view3d_shot_camera_hint: Back to the camera of size and angle (removes the hand camera)
storyboard.view3d_hand_hint: The shot has its own camera from the 3D view – “Shot camera” goes back to size and angle
storyboard.view3d_hint: Drag = orbit · right-drag = pan · wheel = dolly · on a figure: drag = {gesture} · wheel = size · Alt + wheel = turn · Ctrl + Shift + \ folds the view
storyboard.view3d_hint_short: drag orbit · right-drag pan · wheel dolly · figure: drag {gesture}
storyboard.view3d_no_webgl: No 3D here (WebGL is off) – the schematic
storyboard.help: The chapter’s storyboard: the shots in the toon’s order on the left (click = one shot, Ctrl / Shift + click = several), the current shot in the middle, the step’s panels on the right. The steps (keys 1–6) remember their panels; T folds the shots, N the panels.
storyboard.help_workspace: Generated stills and videos live in your workspace folder (Chrome / Edge). Share uploads a file to the shared work storage on our own servers – for signed-in members only, never the readers’ CDN.
storyboard.step_handheld_hint: Film the shot with the phone, trim the takes on the timeline
storyboard.step_export_hint: Render the handheld shots, the chapter's videos and their downloads
storyboard.hh_switch_hint: The phone as this shot's camera
storyboard.hh_connect_hint: A one-time code as a QR code for the phone's page (10 minutes, no sign-in on the phone)
storyboard.hh_scan: Scan with the phone (Chrome; the same Wi-Fi as this computer).
storyboard.hh_failed: No connection ({reason}) – phone and computer in the same Wi-Fi?
storyboard.hh_mode_none: not started on the phone yet
storyboard.hh_smooth_live_hint: Live: 0 = the raw handheld look … 1 = a slow steadicam (a new take keeps it; it can change later per take)
storyboard.hh_smooth_hint: 0 = the raw handheld look … 1 = a slow steadicam
storyboard.hh_scale_hint: 1 m with the phone = this many metres in the scene
storyboard.hh_scale_label: Scale: scene metres per phone metre
storyboard.hh_recenter_hint: The phone's pose now = the shot camera's pose
storyboard.hh_record_hint: Records the phone's moves as a take of this shot (the phone has the same button)
storyboard.hh_trim_hint: The kept part of the take: its in / out on the timeline, in Take mode
storyboard.hh_trim_here: Drag {take}'s in / out on its clip below (I / O at the playhead) – the 3D view shows that moment.
storyboard.hh_render_hint: The trimmed, smoothed take in the studio look as a WebM into your workspace folder (a record names it)
storyboard.hh_rendered: {take} of {shot} rendered into the workspace folder.
storyboard.out_render_hint: Every shot with the handheld camera on and an active take: {n}. Each one takes as long as its take.
storyboard.out_none: No rendered or generated videos yet.
storyboard.tl_mode: View mode – which clip and what the main view shows
storyboard.tl_mode_shot_hint: Every shot a still of 5 s
storyboard.tl_mode_take_hint: The active take, whole, with its in / out (the trim)
storyboard.tl_mode_rendered_hint: The render of the active take (else the take, else a still)
storyboard.tl_mode_generated_hint: The chosen generated video (else the newest; else the render, the take, a still)
storyboard.tl_empty: Pick a shot on the left – Ctrl + click adds more to the timeline.
storyboard.tl_cant_play: the file can't be played here
storyboard.tl_audition_hint: The Variants board's current card plays here – a tag, not a status
